_notes: Hourly USD rate per SINGLE GPU, keyed by provider then by the name nvidia-smi reports (nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader). Figures below are ILLUSTRATIVE and go stale - check your provider's current pricing and edit. Select a provider with REDACT_GPU_PROVIDER; the default 'local' prices at 0 so running on your own machine reports GPU-seconds without inventing a dollar figure. A '*' key is the fallback rate for any GPU under that provider; with no match at all, telemetry reports time only and never guesses.
